strongest_verified_claim: For every finite weakly reversible stochastic mass-action network with one linkage class and complexes of molecularity at most two, every positive rate vector and every initial population have a closed communicating reachability class. Each nonabsorbing class is nonexplosive and positive recurrent with a unique stationary probability; absorbing singletons have their point mass. The genuine-jump embedded chain is also positive recurrent on each nonabsorbing class.
additional_verified_claim: Weak reversibility alone implies symmetric accessibility and closedness of every reachability class, without one-linkage or bimolecular restrictions.
exact_remaining_gap: No unresolved mathematical gap identified within the stated scope; this is not a formal proof certification or external human peer review.
control_issue_resolved: Initial review-only attenuation control used an unjustified relative tolerance at N=10^8. The paper has O_d error; direct calculation and N=10^12 confirm the asymptotic. No manuscript/code repair. Diagnostic retained.
limits: Finite controls do not prove the universal recurrence theorem or enumerate K.
No claim for multiple linkage classes or molecularity above two.
Positive rates are required; K may depend arbitrarily on rates and class.
No proof-assistant formalization or external human peer review.
Primary references checked, but no exhaustive global priority certification.
